title: LoRaWAN: support for Class-B and v1.0.4 specification
description:
This MR is a follow-up of !8182. It fixes several flaws in the LoRaWAN dissector and adds support for new features. Major changes:
* added Class-B beacon dissector
* added Join Accept decryption
* added MAC commands from v1.0.4 specification
* changed AppEUI to DevEUI, fixed offset, added AppKey
* fixed decryption for zero-length downlink
* fixed naming according to LoRaWAN specifications (MType vs FType, RFU, DLSettings)
* fixed decoding of packets without FPort and without FRMPayload
* fixed decoding of Join Request
* changed DevAddr and DevEUI endianness
* separated root and session keys into two dialogs

Test files in pcap format and required keys are available here: https://github.com/alpov/LoRaTap/tree/testfiles.

This patch breaks backward compatibility, as I have separated the original LoRaWAN protocol preferences dialog (LoRaWAN Encryption Keys) into two separate dialogs (LoRaWAN Root Keys and Session Keys). Also, the endianness of the device address and EUI in the dialogs has been changed to comply with the standard. However, I think that very few people may have used the released version so far, as there were some serious bugs.
